source: Client data 2.0.9.0 (NpcData skills, Skill.dat casts / areas / abnormals, Thalythra berserk 300 s) + boss-phases.json (compiled slam and phases, OURS). Stage elites are mapped to Siliator / Ruthilis by their client kit (Naga_01 = Siliator, Naga_02 = Ruthilis; the boss is Thalythra). CANDIDATE = guessed.
note: Stages 1-2 = Normal key, 3-4 = Hard key (the stage grade). Official kit: arcs, circle, 3600x500 line, ranged DefenseDown 16060902, chakram link 1606060 (MoveSpeed 16060602 8 s) and the 1606100 rectangle. The slam is the compiled script's (cooldown 30 s ours, client 42 s). Not implemented: the stagger-break (GroggyGuard 5000) race on the long cast - the client gives no cast time above 2 s, so no check is justified.
